map.📖 查看「纵坡 = 高差 / 平距 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Grade = Rise / Horizontal User Guide"
map.由高差与水平距算坡度%。: Compute slope % from rise and horizontal distance.
map.排水管坡 2%：每 100m 降 2m 保证自流，坡太小易淤、太大冲蚀。: Drain pipe slope 2%: drops 2 m per 100 m to ensure gravity flow; too small silts, too large erodes.
map.坡度%=(高差/水平距)×100，分母是水平距不是斜距。: Slope % = (rise/horizontal) × 100, denominator is horizontal not slant.
map.10% 坡=坡比 1:10；坡比=水平:高差，互为倒数关系。: A 10% slope = ratio 1:10; slope ratio = horizontal:rise, reciprocal relation.
